verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping service with client-facing software, so locking closed periods is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence documents period locking, close dates, or a reopening workflow. The evidence covers automation, categorization, reporting views and working inside a customer's QBO account; any QBO closing-date feature would belong to the host platform, not to Bench.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
